name: Give Lively
description: Give Lively is a free digital-fundraising platform for eligible nonprofits. Organizations use it to launch campaign pages, donation widgets, text-to-donate and event fundraising, accept one-time and recurring gifts, and access real-time donor data and reports.
agentUseSummary: Add the nonprofit's Give Lively Organization ID and Zapier API key, choose which agents may use the connection, and read donation updates from the complete two-endpoint JSON integration. Relay constructs the provider-documented secret-bearing paths only on Railway and never exposes them to agents or audit metadata.

credentialRequirements.label: Give Lively Organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the nonprofit Organization ID from Give Lively's Zapier settings. Relay stores it with the API key and uses it only on the fixed secure.givelively.org JSON routes.

credentialRequirements.label: Give Lively Zapier API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the API key in Give Lively's Nonprofit Admin Portal under Zapier settings. Relay encrypts it and constructs the provider-documented secret-bearing path only on Railway.

capabilities.label: Read donation updates
capabilities.description: Validate one nonprofit's Give Lively integration credentials and read its official donation JSON feed.

allowed.label: Read Give Lively donations
allowed.description: Validate the connected nonprofit credentials and read the official donation JSON feed with an optional created-or-updated-since timestamp.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Credential validation and bounded donation-feed reads run directly; Give Lively documents no mutation endpoint for this integration.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same complete read-only integration surface runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, fixed routes, response bounds, audits and secret isolation still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts Give Lively's complete two-endpoint read-only JSON integration while keeping both path credentials encrypted on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: Give Lively membership is limited to approved eligible nonprofits, and this code-only worker has no member account, Organization ID, Zapier API key or representative donation data.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Give Lively nonprofit administrator enables the Zapier integration, generates a dedicated API key, stores it and the Organization ID through Relay Console, then verifies validation, a bounded recent donation read, key replacement, key deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: Give Lively documents a customer-generated Zapier API key and Organization ID plus exactly two secure.givelively.org JSON endpoints: credential validation and a reverse-chronological donation feed with optional start_time_ms filtering.
Give Lively presents its free nonprofit platform as campaign, widget, text-to-donate, event, donation, donor-data and reporting technology for approved organizations.

Give Lively identifies Salesforce, Zapier, PayPal and Double the Donation as its direct third-party integrations and otherwise directs members to CSV export, so Relay does not invent a broader public API or mutation surface.
